findings.title: Risk Of Self-Invocation
findings.description: The `CopyGossipContactInfo` instruction allows validators to independently invoke the function and update their historical gossip data in the `ValidatorHistory` account without proper external validation. The root cause is the lack of authentication or authorization mechanism to ensure that only valid, broadcasted gossip information is recorded. An attacker (a malicious validator) could exploit this by self-invoking the instruction at the end of each epoch to overwrite their stored gossip information with incorrect or forged data. This would result in inaccurate or malicious data being permanently recorded in the validator history, undermining the integrity of the historical record and potentially affecting downstream systems relying on accurate validator behavior data.
